integrity: A complete analytical proof and standalone exact rational computation are supplied. The computation illustrates, but does not replace, the proof. Relevant broader dynamic-factor literature may imply special cases; no independent originality or correctness audit has been conducted.
scientific_limitations: Identifiability holds for exactly two homogeneous fully observed patches, a symmetric stationary two-state shared Markov environment, conditionally independent Bernoulli renewals, strictly positive environmental amplitude and local persistence below unity. It is structural identifiability of exact two-date moments, not finite-sample estimation or general latent-state model identifiability.
title: Two-census recovery of environmental memory from paired habitat occupancy
